name: canvas
description: Read-only Hanyang Study access across the official timetable, HY-ON, LearningX, Inbox, and saved lecture transcripts.

interface.shortDescription: Review the Hanyang timetable, HY-ON, LearningX, and lectures
interface.longDescription: Review the imported official Hanyang Portal timetable, connected HY-ON account, and saved Study Lecture transcripts through one deliberately read-only assistant. Combine weekly class times and rooms with live courses, assignments, Inbox messages, instructor feedback, posted grades, announcements, LearningX weekly modules and boards, pages, file metadata, calendars, and timestamped lecture evidence without exposing the Canvas PAT.
defaultPrompt: Review my upcoming Hanyang work and flag anything missing or late.
Summarize my unread Hanyang Inbox messages without marking them read.
Summarize this week's deadlines with relevant lecture context.
